scope: Selected source/build, independent engineering outputs and closed native-case evidence. Offline controller mocks are explicitly separate; no product pass follows from them.
normalization: Only literal private workspace/home prefixes become <WORKSPACE>/<HOME>. Numerical data and real image/saved-project bytes remain exact. Original manifests retain original hashes; this mapping binds published copies. PAIRED-RECORDS are labelled derivatives omitting original binary arrays and unrelated system inventories. Native screenshots use a reviewed product-UI allowlist; OS file choosers and other private captures remain private.
